Elise Dubois  
📍 Bengaluru, India | 📧 elise.dubois@nexacouldsolutions.com | 📞 +91 98765 43210 | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/elisedubois  

A seasoned platform engineer with 14 years of experience in designing and scaling infrastructure for enterprise SaaS platforms. Specialized in cloud-native architectures, cost optimization, and automation, with a focus on AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams in deploying resilient systems that support global scalability and operational efficiency.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **AWS**: Spearheaded the migration of CloudNova’s monolithic architecture to AWS, reducing latency by 40% and achieving 99.95% SLA through custom load balancing and auto-scaling. Owned the design of a serverless pipeline for data processing, cutting infrastructure costs by 30% annually.  
- **GCP**: Architectured a hybrid cloud solution for Aether Systems, integrating GCP’s managed services with on-premises systems to reduce maintenance overhead by 25%. Implemented real-time monitoring for critical workloads, improving incident resolution times by 50%.  
- **Cloud Cost Optimization**: Developed a cost governance framework at NexaCloud that reduced redundant resource allocation by 22%, saving $1.2M annually. Automated cost forecasting tools using Python, aligning budgeting with actual usage trends.  
- **Python**: Built a custom CI/CD pipeline for internal tools, reducing deployment cycles from 4 hours to 15 minutes. Instrumented Kubernetes clusters with Python-based observability tools, enhancing troubleshooting efficiency by 35%.  
- **Go**: Rewrote critical components of NexaCloud’s API gateway in Go, improving request handling throughput by 60% and reducing GC overhead.  
- **Prometheus/Grafana**: Established centralized monitoring for all production services, enabling proactive capacity planning and reducing unplanned downtime by 70%.  
- **CI/CD Pipelines**: Modernized Aether Systems’ deployment workflows using Jenkins and GitLab CI, achieving 100% automated testing and deployment for 80% of services.  
- **Cloud Migration**: Led the migration of 12 legacy applications to GCP, ensuring zero data loss and minimal service disruption.  
- **Kubernetes**: Architected a multi-cluster Kubernetes setup for NexaCloud’s global user base, enabling seamless regional scaling and disaster recovery. Mentored 12 engineers in best practices, reducing configuration errors by 45%.  
- **Terraform**: Standardized infrastructure provisioning across AWS and GCP, eliminating manual configuration errors. Created reusable modules for 20+ services, cutting deployment time by 30%.  
- **Infrastructure as Code**: Enforced IaC compliance across all teams, reducing environment drift and ensuring audit readiness for regulatory audits.

- Built a cost-optimization dashboard using Python and Grafana, enabling real-time tracking of spend across 150+ projects.  
- Led the migration of critical services to Kubernetes, improving scalability and reducing manual intervention by 50%.

- Instrumented monitoring for all production services, cutting mean time to detect (MTTD) by 60%.
